fields.title: 📖 The sweetness of Īmān through love for Allah
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in meaning: Whoever loves Allah and His Messenger more than everything else, and loves someone only for Allah, finds the sweetness of Īmān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Love in the Dīn is not mere nearness to people. It becomes pure when it is for Allah and serves Īmān.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Īmān, Bāb: Ḥalāwat al-Īmān, Hadith Nr. 16.
